automatic_failures: critical contradiction of a mandatory fact
claim that Pi project trust is a tool sandbox or built-in permission system
claim that a shorter graph answer is a token saving without passing the same quality gate

mandatory_facts.fact: Interactive submission is handed from InteractiveMode to AgentSession.prompt; an already-streaming submission is queued as steering or follow-up instead of starting a concurrent direct Agent run.

AgentSession owns prompt preflight: extension command/input handling, skill/template expansion, model/auth validation, pre-send compaction check, user message construction, and before_agent_start extension injection.
Agent snapshots system prompt, transcript, and tools, creates one abort-controlled active run, and invokes the reusable agent loop.

The loop emits agent/turn/user-message lifecycle events, applies context transformation, converts AgentMessage to provider Message, and builds the provider Context from system prompt, messages, and tools.
The coding-agent stream function delegates through ModelRuntime to the selected provider's normalized streamSimple implementation with runtime auth/config and request options.

Provider start/delta/done/error events update a partial assistant message and emit message_start, message_update, and message_end; Agent reduces those events into public in-memory state before listeners run.
Tool calls are resolved by name, arguments are validated, optional beforeToolCall policy can block them, and tools receive the active abort signal and may stream updates.

Tool batches are sequential when configured or forced by a tool, otherwise parallel; finalized results become toolResult messages keyed by tool-call ID and are appended to context in assistant source order.
After tool results the loop emits turn_end and normally makes another model turn; it also handles termination hints, steering, follow-ups, graceful stop, and final agent_end.
Finalized user, assistant, and tool-result messages persist on message_end as parent-linked JSONL session entries; session ID and tool-call ID are distinct identities with different roles.
InteractiveMode converts session stream/tool/end events into components and render requests; Pi TUI coalesces requests and performs full or differential terminal writes.
Cancellation propagates through the Agent abort signal, but Pi has no built-in tool sandbox or general permission system; project trust only gates project-local resource loading.

dimensions.name: factual_precision
dimensions.score_2: No material contradiction; package and boundary ownership are accurate.
dimensions.score_1: Mostly accurate with one non-critical conflation or overstatement.
dimensions.score_0: Materially wrong control flow, ownership, or trust claim.

dimensions.name: required_fact_coverage
dimensions.score_2: All twelve mandatory facts are present.
dimensions.score_1: Nine to eleven mandatory facts are present.
dimensions.score_0: Fewer than nine mandatory facts are present.

dimensions.name: source_citation_correctness
dimensions.score_2: Every material claim has a real, supporting repo-relative source citation.
dimensions.score_1: Citations are real but one or more material claims are weakly supported.
dimensions.score_0: A citation is fabricated, materially mismatched, or absent for central claims.

dimensions.name: causal_mechanism
dimensions.score_2: Explains the ordered causal path through input, provider stream, tools, persistence, and rendering.
dimensions.score_1: Mostly ordered but omits or merely lists one central transition.
dimensions.score_0: Primarily a component inventory with no reliable lifecycle.

dimensions.name: uncertainty_handling
dimensions.score_2: Separates source facts, inference, and open questions and avoids provider/runtime generalization.
dimensions.score_1: Acknowledges some uncertainty but leaves an important assumption implicit.
dimensions.score_0: Presents inference or configuration-dependent behavior as universal fact.

dimensions.name: learning_value
dimensions.score_2: Provides a coherent systems mental model with state, identity, control/data, trust, failure, and rendering boundaries.
dimensions.score_1: Useful trace but weak on one or more system boundaries.
dimensions.score_0: Too syntactic, fragmented, or tool-marketing-oriented to teach the system.

review_rules.valid_extra_facts: Verify against frozen source before credit; do not penalize merely because absent from this key.
review_rules.near_threshold_or_disputed: Record the dispute and request user approval before any separate model reviewer.
